text_block_list.text:
It happened while I was proposing
a training regimen to Admire Vega.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...It's nothing.
I'm just going to get some fresh air—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Don't worry about it.
I took my medicine, so it'll pass soon—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself if it's too tough.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right.
I should have kept you updated on my condition."

It seems Admire Vega
is troubled by a headache...
